name: Tectonic Shelf
introDiscord:
A Leviathan skeleton lies beneath so much sediment that an entire shelf
has grown across its back.

The Barnacles here have mistaken ancient bones for geological features.

Fair.
introTwitch:
A Leviathan skeleton lies beneath so much sediment that an entire shelf
has grown across its back.

The Barnacles here have mistaken ancient bones for geological features.

Fair.

tectonic-shelf-approach.prompt: Three routes cross what appears to be ordinary bedrock.

left.message:
A Tectonic Barnacle opens.

The 'boulder' beside it opens too.

Geology becomes combat.

right.message: A wrecked strongbox rests inside a crack.

forward.message:
Shizuki's note beside a spring reads:

'Standing on Leviathan.

Thought was mountain.

Difference is upsetting.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the spring and continue standing on former wildlife.

tectonic-shelf-depths.prompt: The shelf trembles beneath three paths.

left.message: Star Candies sit beneath the edge of a buried scale.

right.message: A Barnacle clamps open from the seabed.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's sign:

'NOT ROCK.

I checked.

Well.

Eventually.'

left.message:
A mineral pool rests inside an old fracture.

Shizuki wrote:

'If ground moves:

remain calm.

If ground has mouth:

different problem.'

right.message: A navigator's chest rests beneath compacted sediment.

forward.message:
A Tectonic Barnacle opens directly beneath the route.

Different problem.

bossPromptDiscord:
The shelf begins lifting.

Not shaking.

Lifting.

An enormous crown of stone-covered plates opens at its center.

Use /yes to approach Moving Bedrock or /no to stop trusting geology.
bossPromptTwitch:
The shelf begins lifting.

Not shaking.

Lifting.

An enormous crown of stone-covered plates opens at its center.

Use !yes to approach Moving Bedrock or !no to stop trusting geology.
bossRetreatText: You retreat onto different questionable geology.

boss.revealText:
The stone shell splits wide.

Quake-Crown Barnacle reveals itself!

completionText:
The shelf settles.

Nothing moves.

You trust nothing.
